mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, username, email, password_hash, name, status, fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, organization_id FROM users WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, uuid, username, email, password_hash, name, status, fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, organization_id FROM users WHERE email_hash = #{emailHash} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'LOCKED', locked_until = #{until}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE username = #{username} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, uuid, username, email AS email, password_hash, name, status, fail_count, locked_until, last_login_at, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, organization_id FROM users WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, uuid, username, email AS email, name, status, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM users
deleted_at IS NULL
AND (username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR email ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND status = #{status}
ORDER BY
updated_at DESC updated_at ASC username ASC username DESC last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST last_login_at ASC NULLS LAST created_at ASC created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users
deleted_at IS NULL
AND (username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR email ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND status = #{status}

SELECT u.id, u.uuid, u.username, u.email AS email, u.name, u.status, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM users u
JOIN organization o ON o.id = u.organization_id
u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (u.username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR u.name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR u.email ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
AND o.path LIKE #{orgPathPrefix} || '%' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY
u.updated_at DESC u.updated_at ASC u.username ASC u.username DESC u.last_login_at DESC NULLS LAST u.last_login_at ASC NULLS LAST u.created_at ASC u.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users u
JOIN organization o ON o.id = u.organization_id
u.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (u.username ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR u.name ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR u.email ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
AND o.path LIKE #{orgPathPrefix} || '%' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, name, status, password_changed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, 'ACTIVE'), NOW(), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = COALESCE(#{email}, email), name = COALESCE(#{name}, name), status = COALESCE(#{status,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, status), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_code, granted_at, granted_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{roleCode}, #{now}, #{grantedBy}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_code) DO NOTHING
